pl505085395.description: The archaeological sites at Amnya, located in a bend of the homonymous river in Western Siberia, have been demonstrated to be perhaps among the earliest instances of fortified human settlement ca. 6000 BCE.

cur-fossil-mamontovaya-kurya.dateNote: In 2001 Pavel Pavlov's team reported stone tools and a mammoth tusk with cut marks at Mamontovaya Kurya, on the Usa River in the far north of European Russia. They are about 40,000 years old (0.04 million years).
cur-fossil-mamontovaya-kurya.summary: One of the oldest signs of people near the Arctic Circle, 40,000 years ago.
